levels.surface: أبي نعيم محمد بن أحمد الانصاري

notes: the opening «عنه» takes the shaykh that prev1 writes first (أحمد بن علي الرازي) as inherited; the owner ruling calls «عنه» a back-reference to the previous report's last teacher (أحمد بن عبد الله الهاشمي), which would give a different head: flagged for the ruling

the narrative is an eyewitness account in which an unnamed Imam of the time and quoted prayers of Abu Abdullah, Amir al-Mu'minin and Ali b. al-Husayn appear: whether the saying is sourced from them or only inside the encounter is the ruling
the first-person «كنت حاضرا» is Abu Nu'aym's own speech; he is the last link
